newsitem.title: BULGARIA: DELOITTE & TOUCHE TO AUDIT BULGARIAN NATIONAL BANK.
newsitem.headline: DELOITTE & TOUCHE TO AUDIT BULGARIAN NATIONAL BANK.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) proposed to appoint international auditors Deloitte & Touche to audit its 1996 balance sheet, a BNB official said on Friday.
"The central bank will offer to parliament's budget and finance committee Deloitte & Touche to audit its 1996 balance sheet," a BNB official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.

Under a reform and lending agreement with the International Monetary Fund, Bulgaria is due to complete a 1996 international audit of the BNB before introducing a self-regulating restrictive monetary system, known as a currency board, in July.
Deloitte & Touche did BNB's 1995 international audit after winning a tender among four other foreign auditors.
The BNB will not hold a tender this year due to lack of time, said the official.
Parliament's budget and finance committee is expected to approve the proposal next week. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981-4145
